saw_lines: Bedding gets bought when the old set wears out, and buyers check price, delivery and returns before they pay.
So the offer and the delivery answer have to sit in the first line, or the buyer scrolls past before deciding.
Your site offers 10% off the first order, yet 0 of 23 ads mention it. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative itself.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers 10% off the first order, yet 0 of 23 ads mention it, so a first time buyer has no reason to act. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative itself.

Your site offers free shipping over EGP 5,000, but 0 of 25 ads mention shipping or delivery. A buyer who cannot tell how the order arrives hesitates. Put the EGP 5,000 threshold and delivery time in line one of new ads.
None of your 25 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust you over other stores. Collect one real figure, a review count or orders shipped, and lead with it in the next batch.

Seven Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product shown. A shopper who taps a pillow and lands on a general page must search again. Point each of the seven to the product or collection its creative shows.
